snippet.title: 高中生模拟器 [The Existence Theory of the No.13 High School] // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3651010/The_Existence_Theory_of_the_No13_High_School/

This is a text-based adventure game about a Chinese high school, where you will experience the joys or pains, the richness or meaninglessness of high school life by rolling dice and making choices.

Developed by 
有逝先走
